content.text:
{
  "hazard_consequence_node": [
    {
      "label": "HazardConsequence",
      "name": "VCE",
      "node_id": "H1",
      "node_type": "HazardConsequence",
      "evidence": "The report states that \"the explosion was fueled by vapor released from a 2000-gallon tank of highly flammable liquid\" and that an open steam valve most likely caused the liquid to overheat and accumulate in the building to a near-ideal vapor-air concentration. It further concludes that \"an unknown ignition source ignited the flammable atmosphere, causing the explosion.\" The technical analysis identifies heptane and propyl alcohol vapors released from mix tank 3, accumulating in the closed, unventilated building and then igniting as the main event.",
      "explanation": "The primary hazardous consequence is a vapor cloud explosion: flammable solvent vapors were generated from an overheated unsealed process tank, accumulated in the building, and ignited, producing the destructive overpressure that is the main focus of the investigation. The subsequent long-duration fire was a secondary consequence.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "entity_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Material",
      "name": "heptane, isopropyl alcohol, and normal propyl alcohol",
      "node_id": "En1",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "a more than 2000-gallon liquid mixture of heptane, isopropyl alcohol, and normal propyl alcohol",
      "explanation": "These flammable solvents were charged to mix tank 3, heated, vaporized, and their vapors fueled the explosion.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Location",
      "name": "mix tank 3",
      "node_id": "En2",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "a 2000-gallon ink vehicle batch containing more than 10,000 pounds of flammable liquid in mix tank 3",
      "explanation": "Mix tank 3 was the process vessel where the solvent mixture was heated and from which vapor was released.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Location",
      "name": "production area of the CAI/Arnel building",
      "node_id": "En3",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "accumulate in the building production area",
      "explanation": "The solvent vapor accumulated and mixed in this enclosed building area before ignition.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "condition_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Phase",
      "name": "Vapor",
      "node_id": "C1",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "released enough heptane/alcohol vapor into the unventilated building to fuel the explosion",
      "explanation": "The hazardous material was present as a flammable vapor cloud at the time of the explosion.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Temperature",
      "name": "High temperature",
      "node_id": "C2",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "most likely caused the flammable liquid to overheat",
      "explanation": "Uncontrolled steam heating raised the solvent mixture temperature until it boiled and generated vapor.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Volatility",
      "name": "High volatility",
      "node_id": "C3",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "forms a low-boiling (positive) azeotrope with an average boiling point of 165.6°F",
      "explanation": "The low-boiling solvent mixture readily vaporized when heated, promoting vapor cloud formation.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Combustibility",
      "name": "Combustible",
      "node_id": "C4",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "CAI heated Class I flammable liquids in unsealed tanks inside a closed building",
      "explanation": "The solvent mixture was flammable and capable of supporting ignition and explosion.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "ReleaseType",
      "name": "Continuous release",
      "node_id": "C5",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "As long as the steam valve was open, the boiling mixture would continue to release many hundreds of pounds of flammable vapor",
      "explanation": "The vapor release occurred over hours while the steam valve remained open and the mixture boiled.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Confinement",
      "name": "High confinement",
      "node_id": "C6",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "the vapor cloud accumulated and was confined inside the closed CAI/Arnel building",
      "explanation": "The closed building confined the vapor cloud and increased explosion severity.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Dispersion",
      "name": "Dispersed",
      "node_id": "C7",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "thoroughly mix the heptane and alcohol vapor throughout the production area",
      "explanation": "The released vapor dispersed through the production area and formed a near-homogeneous flammable mixture.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "event_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "InitiatingEvent",
      "name": "Steam valve on mix tank 3 left open, allowing the flammable mixture to boil",
      "node_id": "Ev1",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "the mix tank 3 heater steam valve was left open, allowing the flammable mixture to boil in the unsealed tank",
      "explanation": "Leaving the steam valve open initiated the abnormal overheating and vapor generation sequence.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "IgnitionSource",
      "name": "Unknown ignition source",
      "node_id": "Ev2",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "An unknown ignition source ignited the flammable atmosphere, causing the explosion",
      "explanation": "The report confirms ignition occurred, but the exact ignition source could not be identified.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ]
}
